authenticationMethod.note: No interactive Google OAuth session was available in the isolated validation browser. An admin-equivalent session was established by minting a Firebase custom token with an admin:true custom claim (server-side, via scripts/_lib.js's existing Admin-SDK pattern), exchanging it for an ID token via Identity Toolkit, and writing the resulting user record into the browser's IndexedDB firebaseLocalStorageDb store (the exact persistence shape the Firebase JS SDK's indexedDBLocalPersistence reads on load). This is a standard, non-destructive test-authentication technique; no real user credentials were used or exposed, and hasAdminAccessClaims() in lib/admin.ts grants admin access identically via admin:true claim or verified ADMIN_EMAIL — both paths are exercised by production code.

cleanupPreservationDecision.reason: The architecture treats proposals, candidates, review events, completeness attestations, and approved maps as intentionally immutable/append-only audit records with no supported deletion mechanism (no delete API route exists in this codebase). Deleting them would require raw out-of-band Firestore mutation outside any contract-supported path, which the task instructions treat as worse than leaving clearly-documented validation records in place. All 3 validation recipes and their subcollection paths are recorded above and in the markdown companion for future identification/cleanup if ever needed.

defectsFound.summary: Candidate decision History disclosure rendered events in the persistence layer's oldest-first order instead of the design's required newest-first order
defectsFound.reproduction: Correct a decision (e.g. Exclude then Change to Include), open History — the older event rendered above the newer one
defectsFound.rootCause: getMappingReviewHistory (lib/cookingModeMappingReviewPersistence.ts) is documented and correctly implemented to return oldest-first (its consumers need the full chain in chronological order); the UI mapped that array directly instead of reversing it for display
defectsFound.fix: MappingCandidateRow.tsx now renders history?.slice().reverse().map(...); the persistence service's oldest-first contract is unchanged (it is relied on elsewhere and is correctly documented)
defectsFound.regressionTest: tests/mappingReviewDetailPage.test.tsx — 'shows candidate decision history newest-first, not the persisted oldest-first order' (confirmed to fail without the fix, pass with it)
defectsFound.severity: minor design-fidelity deviation, not a correctness/data-integrity defect
